The '''Perlemian Charter''' was a document. The [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] owned the only known copy of the charter, and he stored it inside [[Xizor's Palace|his palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
